title: Social media
slide_intent: Teach designers to make a small feed tile understandable alone and recognizable among related posts.
strategic_value: Millennium Gallery can vary image, message and color across posts while its framed venue mark recurs in the sequence.
demonstration: A phone mockup shows an image-led museum account post. A row of square artworks extends from the phone, alternating venue lettering with exhibition promotion.
practical_value: Choose which tile introduces the venue and which carries the exhibition message. Check each at feed scale.

content_islands.name: Phone specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the phone at left with account name, artwork, post controls and caption visible.

content_islands.name: Square tile sequence
content_islands.spec: Align the pink venue tile, My Path exhibition tile and pale venue tile in one row beside the phone. Repeat the venue lettering across the two colored fields.
